headline: Argentine Police Search Banco Hipotecario and Banco Industrial in AML Probe
summary: Argentine federal authorities carried out searches at four locations of Banco Hipotecario and Banco Industrial as part of a judicial inquiry into anti-money laundering controls.
why: Regulatory and legal crackdowns on Argentine financial institutions can affect compliance costs, operational licenses, and domestic credit.

impacts.name: Banco Hipotecario
impacts.why: Police searches connected to AML violations pose direct legal and reputational risks to the lender.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
